primary: n13,m5 for both directions; n13,m2 is the explicitly frozen dilution control
curves: All capacity-feasible integer n with every fixed path, reporting support at each point
Same metadata cohort supporting both m at n13, while retaining any further support loss at large n
Balanced metadata cohort supporting both m for the fixed n5..21 pressure span
cohort_selection: Capacity and metadata only; never selected by score, geometry, direction success or failure
aggregation: Replicate events within reference pool, reference pools equally within true image ID, images equally within building, buildings equally; pool and true-image support always separate
geometry: Frozen old joint strict/main/wide, noQ geometry and new shape remain separate, together with floor/prism/node/wall/corner diagnostics
quality: Signed C-B B8L2 primary and D10 sensitivity; within/cross absolute changes, per-pool descriptive p10/p90, decline>5, endpoint quality and failures separately
failures: Incomplete and unscorable endpoints retain attempted denominators; absent capacity is no experiment and is not a failed team or score zero
step_localization: All successive integer-n steps of the identical frozen block/core path; score/node/corner change and recorded minimum-support increments reported, with class of the single shared added person. Local largest steps are mechanism illustrations, not newly validated threshold hypotheses
identity_sensitivity: At frozen n13/m2 and n13/m5, delete events involving each worker in replaceable blocks; retain changed support, empty cases and all signs. Descriptive deletion does not identify a causal person effect
independence: Two paths, many n, repeated people, and new teams are not new independent images or buildings. No external blind-test claim
design_relation_between_m: m2 and m5 use separate frozen block/core draws; nesting is exact across n within each m/path, not exact person matching between m scales
outcome_boundary_at_plan_write: Native and metric summaries are running; no assessment effect or curve has been opened for selection. Only metadata capacity and completion receipts observed
